import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(input[0])
    scores = defaultdict(int)
    max_score = 0
    leader = None

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        name, score = input[i].split()
        score = int(score)
        scores[name] += score
        if scores[name] > max_score:
            max_score = scores[name]
            leader = name

    print(leader)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
